summary: TRACK 14.0-SAFETY-INCIDENT-AUTH-LIFECYCLE-RUNTIME-CERTIFICATION + AMENDMENT A. Backend pytest: 22/22 PASS (admin endpoints, health board, lifecycle role matrix). Frontend playwright: STABILITY-1, STABILITY-3, STABILITY-4, and LIFECYCLE-1 all PASS. STABILITY-2 REPRODUCED THE USER-REPORTED P0 BUG: false 'Session Expired' modal overlays the Safety incident detail page when accessed with only a Safety token. Root cause: UndoLastTransitionButton.refresh() calls /api/workflows/incident/{id}/last-transition which returns 401 for non-admin tokens, and this path is NOT in the namespaced-silent list in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js, so the 401 still publishes the global session_expired event. STABILITY-2 also missing data-testid='safety-nav-back' on the safety incident detail page (uses 'back-link' instead because ViewIncident is not wrapped in SafetyShell).

ui_bugs.issue: GET /workflows/{workflow}/{id}/last-transition returns 401 for Safety users and triggers the global Session Expired modal because the call does NOT pass skipSessionStatus:true and /api/workflows/* is not in api.js namespaced-silent list. This is the EXACT user-reported P0 bug.

data-testid='safety-nav-back' not rendered on /safety-portal/incidents/:id (page uses 'back-link' instead). Acceptance criteria asked for safety-nav-back. Suggest wrapping safety route in SafetyShell or adding safety-nav-back testid.

integration_issues.issue: Background workflow /last-transition 401 triggers false session_expired modal — user cannot dismiss without losing content view; same class of bug TRACK 14.0 set out to eliminate.

action_items: P0: Fix UndoLastTransitionButton.refresh() in /app/frontend/src/components/UndoLastTransitionButton.jsx — pass {skipSessionStatus: true} as second arg to api.get(`/workflows/${workflow}/${recordId}/last-transition`, {skipSessionStatus: true}). Also consider the same for the undo POST call to avoid future regressions. Alternative: include `/api/workflows/*` in the namespaced-silent-401 list in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js (preferred — single source of truth).

MEDIUM: Add data-testid='safety-nav-back' to the back link rendered on /safety-portal/incidents/:id. Either wrap ViewIncident with SafetyShell when route is /safety-portal/incidents/:id, or add the testid to whatever shell currently emits 'back-link'.
VERIFY-AFTER-FIX: Re-run the Safety-only-token soak (clear localStorage, set ONLY masci.safety.token, open detail, confirm NO session_status_overlay).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js: namespaced-silent-401 logic is incomplete — only matches portal prefixes (/api/admin, /api/safety, /api/pm, /api/shop, /api/hr, /api/dispatch). Cross-portal helpers like /api/workflows/*, /api/incidents/*/lifecycle, /api/notifications/* can also 401 for legitimate non-admin viewers. Consider switching to an allow-list of paths that ARE allowed to pop the modal (e.g., /api/auth/me, /api/auth/refresh) rather than a portal-prefix block-list.

/app/frontend/src/components/UndoLastTransitionButton.jsx line 41-52: catch swallows error correctly for state hiding, but the 401 still propagates through the axios interceptor before the catch — that's where the modal is published. Adding {skipSessionStatus:true} is the minimal correct fix.

ViewIncident shell inconsistency: same component renders the same testids ('back-link') for both /admin/incidents/:id and /safety-portal/incidents/:id, breaking the SafetyShell back-button contract assumed by the acceptance criteria.

success_rate.frontend: 5/6 acceptance flows PASS, 1 P0 FAIL (STABILITY-2 false modal)

context_for_next_testing_agent: After the api.js or UndoLastTransitionButton fix, re-run the Safety-only-token detail-page test: (1) multi-login, extract portal_tokens.safety, (2) localStorage.clear(); set ONLY masci.safety.token, (3) visit /safety-portal/incidents, click incident-open-0, (4) assert NO session-status-overlay visible for 10s. The bug is deterministic and reproduces every time.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: 1) POST /api/auth/multi-login {jaymn.judd@mascigc.com, Maddix123!}. 2) Set ONLY localStorage.masci.safety.token. 3) Visit /safety-portal/incidents. 4) Click incident-open-0. 5) Detail loads, then within ~1s the 'Session Expired' modal overlays the page. Network shows GET /api/workflows/incident/{id}/last-transition returning 401 twice. Root cause: UndoLastTransitionButton.jsx (line 41) calls api.get without {skipSessionStatus:true}; axios interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js sees a 401 on a non-namespaced /api/workflows/* path and publishes a global session_expired event because the route prefix isn't in the namespaced-silent list. Mitigation (smallest patch): pass {skipSessionStatus:true} to the api.get call in UndoLastTransitionButton.refresh(). Better fix: extend the namespaced-silent matcher in api.js to include /api/workflows/* (and any other cross-portal helper endpoints).
